theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (c : ℝ → Euclid n → Euclid (n + 1)) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Ω : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (Θ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) (t : ℝ), (∀ s w, c s w 0 = s ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, c s w i.succ = w i) → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Θ Ω → InjOn Θ Ω → (∀ z ∈ Ω, Injective (fderiv ℝ Θ z)) → Θ '' Ω ⊆ V → (∀ z ∈ Ω, F (Θ z) = z 0) → IsOpen {w | c t w ∈ Ω} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun w => ψ (Θ (c t w))) {w | c t w ∈ Ω} ∧ InjOn (fun w => ψ (Θ (c t w))) {w | c t w ∈ Ω} ∧ ∀ w, c t w ∈ Ω → fderiv ℝ F (Θ (c t w)) ≠ 0 ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => ψ (Θ (c t w'))) w) ∧ ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ (Θ (c t w)) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ e, inner ℝ v (fderiv ℝ ψ (Θ (c t w)) e) = fderiv ℝ F (Θ (c t w)) e) → LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => ψ (Θ (c t w'))) w : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ (Θ (c t w)) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ ∧ Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w' => ψ (Θ (c t w'))) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w' => ψ (Θ (c t w'))) w).det) = ‖v‖ * Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ ψ (Θ (c t w))).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ (Θ (c t w))).det) * |(fderiv ℝ Θ (c t w)).det|
